ablation_behavior_off: Set eta_l=0 at every level, leaving the same Poincare RQ-VAE and all other losses unchanged.
ablation_both_on: Use transition-derived b_i and Poincare residual displacement/assignment/subtraction throughout; train and evaluate the same Stage3 pipeline.
ablation_geometry_off: Replace exp/log/Mobius operations and d_c with Euclidean vector addition/subtraction and squared Euclidean distance, retaining identical transition distributions, gates, eta schedule, and codebook sizes.
behavior_computation: On Stage2 training interactions only, count adjacent distinct items within each user's ordered sequence; divide transition counts by source row sum after multiplying each edge count by (1+target training frequency)^-0.5; retain top 32 outgoing targets and normalize. Create barycenters from frozen Stage1 embeddings mapped into the fixed-curvature ball.
behavior_signal: Popularity-adjusted directed next-item transition distribution for each item.
cost_estimate: Precompute truncated outgoing distributions/barycenters in O(E_train log 32) and store one tangent vector per item. Each RQ level adds one log-map/geodesic step per item and a scalar gate; pairwise codeword distance remains baseline complexity. At 24,556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3,000 epochs (72,000 steps), cache b_i and compute the per-item flow once per quantizer forward; expected 10–25% overhead depending on latent dimension and number of residual levels.
coupling_path: The row-normalized training transition distribution determines b_i; b_i enters the Poincare log/exp residual displacement; the displaced curved point is the actual input to the codeword argmin. Removing either makes a different residual and SID.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Directed consumption flow has a useful local tangent direction not recoverable from static item text; steering residual quantization toward that direction should shift residual SIDs to encode successor-relevant distinctions and raise Stage3 test Recall@10 above 0.065.
hyperbolic_location: In every residual quantization level of Stage2: the current residual is geometrically displaced toward its training-only outgoing barycenter before code assignment, and residual subtraction returns through the curved log map.
hyperbolic_operator: Poincare exp/log maps, parallel point displacement via exp_R, Mobius subtraction, and geodesic distance with fixed curvature -c (c=1).
key_change: Estimate each item's popularity-adjusted outgoing transition barycenter from training sequences, then at each RQ level move the current residual a small fraction along the Poincare log-map direction toward that barycenter. Quantize the moved residual by Poincare distance and subtract the chosen codeword using the same curved residual operation.
leakage_boundary: The transition matrix is built only from training users' training-period adjacent pairs. Item frequencies, neighbour lists, and barycenters are frozen before tokenizer fitting; no validation/test sequence, target, frequency, or model output participates.
motivation: Text reconstruction alone can spend residual capacity on distinctions that do not help predict what users consume next; directed training transitions provide an explicit recommendation-oriented direction for residual code selection.
novelty: Unlike graph-neighbour reweighting of ordinary nearest-neighbour VQ, transition flow is transported into the Poincare tangent space and steers the residual along a curved geodesic before each residual quantization decision. It modifies the residual state itself, so behaviour and geometry cannot be separated into unrelated losses.
observables: Residual digits should change more for items with confident outgoing distributions; held-out prefix-to-next-item accuracy and Stage3 Recall@10 should improve. Main target is Stage3 test Recall@10 >0.065, compared at matched validation selection.
risks: Flow may encode popularity rather than conditional preference; outgoing neighbours can be noisy for low-degree items; repeated steering can distort reconstruction or erase useful semantics; Frechet-mean approximation in a tangent chart may be biased for broad neighbourhoods.
safeguards: Project ball points to norm <=(1-epsilon)/sqrt(c); clamp atanh arguments; clip tangent norms before exp; if no outgoing transition set eta=0; smooth popularity with +1; cap neighbour probabilities and eta (initial eta <=0.1); detach cached barycenters; monitor reconstruction and flow displacement norms for divergence; use fixed seed and identical preprocessing in geometry-off arm.
spec_equations: For curvature -c, Mobius addition x opplus_c y=((1+2c<x,y>+c||y||^2)x+(1-c||x||^2)y)/(1+2c<x,y>+c^2||x||^2||y||^2); d_c(x,y)=2/sqrt(c)*atanh(sqrt(c)||(-x)oplus_c y||); log_x(y)=2/(sqrt(c)*lambda_x)*atanh(sqrt(c)||(-x)oplus_c y||)*((-x)oplus_c y), lambda_x=2/(1-c||x||^2); exp_x(v)=x opplus_c [tanh(sqrt(c)*lambda_x||v||/2)*v/(sqrt(c)||v||)]. Use these formulae for displacement and assignment; use tangent residual norm clipping.
spec_inputs_outputs: Inputs: train-only ordered user sequences, frozen item embeddings, encoder outputs, per-item outgoing distribution P_i, tangent codebooks at each level, curvature c and eta_l. Outputs: first-level and residual SID indices, plus reconstructed embedding for the standard RQ-VAE losses.

specification.text: From training directed counts A_ij, set P_ij=(A_ij+eps)/(sum_l A_il+eps*|N(i)|), retaining at most 32 outgoing neighbours by P_ij; downweight each count by target popularity^-0.5 before row normalization. Let b_i be the Poincare weighted Frechet-mean approximation exp_0^c(sum_j P_ij log_0^c(z_j)), z_j=exp_0^c(enc(x_j)). For item i at level l, residual r_l in tangent coordinates maps to R_l=exp_0^c(r_l); compute flow f_i=log_{R_l}(b_i), clip norm, and set R'_l=exp_{R_l}^c(eta_l * sigmoid(s_i) * f_i), where s_i=log(1+outdegree_i). Choose k_l=argmin_k d_c(R'_l, exp_0^c(v_lk))^2; update R_{l+1}=log_0^c((-q_lk)oplus_c R'_l), where q_lk=exp_0^c(v_lk). Use straight-through assignment and baseline reconstruction plus commitment losses.

title: Transition-flow geodesic residual quantization
